data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_01
data.value: Hello there! The new seeds just came in. Have a good look.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_02
data.value: Sow in the right season and the plants grow strong, with big fruit.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_03
data.value: Damp soil is my favourite smell.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_04
data.value: Stop by before you head to the fields. I'll have what you need.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_05
data.value: Spring is here, and the beans and radishes just came in.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_06
data.value: The summer sun is strong, and the tomatoes and melons are looking lovely.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_07
data.value: Autumn is here. Pumpkins and yams are best planted now.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_08
data.value: Winter is cold and the fields rest. Come in and have some tea to warm up.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_09
data.value: Rain all day and the soil is soft. Today is the best day to sow.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_10
data.value: Snow covers the fields. Come in and dream about next season's seeds.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_11
data.value: Early morning is the best time for the fields, with dew still on the leaves.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_12
data.value: Evening is coming. Water your plants before you rest.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_13
data.value: Welcome to the village! I'm Mai. Ask me anything you need.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_14
data.value: Your first harvest looked wonderful. Try a different crop next time.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_15
data.value: The spring morning is cool. Seeds sown now sprout quickly.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Line_16
data.value: Summer midday is hot. Take water with you to the fields.

data.name: Npc_seed_keeper_Quest_buy_seeds
data.value: Planning what to grow? The seeds are right here on this counter.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Quest_upgrade_tool
data.value: Want a tool upgraded? Hand it over and I'll take care of the rest.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Quest_build_coop
data.value: Thinking of a coop? Pick a plan here, then set it down on your farm.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Quest_buy_animal
data.value: Once you have a coop, you'll want a first animal. Choose one here.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Quest_decorate
data.value: Decorating? Buy a piece of furniture here and set it down.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Quest_fill_request
data.value: There's a request on the board. Bring what they want and it's done.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_01
data.value: Come in and look around. The new shirts are cut to fit.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_02
data.value: These trousers are hard-wearing for fieldwork. You can rely on them.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_03
data.value: I sew every seam myself, so nothing comes undone.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_04
data.value: Try things on before you buy. A good fit is what makes it comfortable.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_05
data.value: Spring is here and the straw hats are back on the shelf, cool for sowing.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_06
data.value: The summer sun is harsh. Wear a straw hat to keep it off your skin.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_07
data.value: The air is turning cool. The new caps just arrived, try one on.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_08
data.value: Winter is biting. Put on a wool jumper so you don't catch cold.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_09
data.value: Soaked through out there? Come in out of the rain and look at the new shirts.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_10
data.value: Snow and bitter cold. I've just finished a thick jumper for you.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_11
data.value: The mornings are quiet, and that's when I like to sew.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_12
data.value: It's evening. My lamps stay lit late, so drop by any time.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_13
data.value: Hello! I'm Hanh. Try anything you like, nobody will push you to buy.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_14
data.value: A good harvest deserves good clothes. Time to dress up a little.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_15
data.value: Spring mornings are cool. A light shirt is just right for work.

data.name: Npc_tailor_Line_16
data.value: Summer midday is hot. Pick something breathable to stay comfortable.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_01
data.value: Hello! A nice home makes the work feel lighter.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_02
data.value: My oak furniture has lasted decades without a crack.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_03
data.value: One lamp and one plant, and the room looks completely different.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_04
data.value: Take your time. Buy what suits your home, and nothing more.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_05
data.value: Spring is here. Flower boxes are very popular right now.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_06
data.value: Summer is here, and every home needs a cool chair to rest in.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_07
data.value: Autumn is here. Pumpkin decorations by the door look so warm.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_08
data.value: In winter a rug and a long bench keep the whole house warm.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_09
data.value: On a rainy day, a bench and a warm lamp are the best company.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_10
data.value: Snow is falling. A winter wreath at the door says a cosy season has come.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_11
data.value: In the morning, a window that catches the sun looks its best.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_12
data.value: When evening comes, a table lamp warms up the whole house.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_13
data.value: Welcome! I'm Tam. A new home can start with just one chair.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_14
data.value: Business is good now. Treat your home to something lovely.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_15
data.value: A spring morning reading beside a flower box is a real treat.

data.name: Npc_furnisher_Line_16
data.value: Back from the deep mine? You need a soft seat to rest in.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_01
data.value: Hm, a customer. Coal, ore, or an upgrade for your tools?

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_02
data.value: A good tool is half the work. Keep the blade sharp.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_03
data.value: The forge stays hot from dawn to dusk, and iron never waits.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_04
data.value: Bring me ore and I'll forge you something that lasts.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_05
data.value: Spring soil is soft and easy to dig. Bring your hoe in to sharpen it.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_06
data.value: Summer is hot and my forge is hotter. Don't stand too close.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_07
data.value: Autumn is a good time to upgrade your tools before winter.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_08
data.value: Winter cold makes iron brittle, but my forge never goes out.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_09
data.value: On a wet day the workshop is the best place to be. The hammering sounds cheerful.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_10
data.value: Snow is falling. I stoked the forge up, so come warm your hands.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_11
data.value: I start hammering at dawn, and the whole street hears it.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_12
data.value: Evening. The coal glows red in the forge. A lovely sight.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_13
data.value: Hello, I'm Cuong. Tell me straight what you need.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_14
data.value: With a harvest in, now is the right time to upgrade your tools.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_15
data.value: The deep mine has plenty of rock. Bring the iron ore up to me.

data.name: Npc_blacksmith_Line_16
data.value: Midday is noisy in here. Don't let the hammering startle you.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_01
data.value: Ah, you're here. Coops, barns, I can build them all.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_02
data.value: Chickens need hay every evening, and so do cows. Don't let them go hungry.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_03
data.value: A building takes a few days, but built well it lasts a lifetime.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_04
data.value: Good timber, solid stone. I'm glad of a chat with you too.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_05
data.value: Spring is the best time to build. The ground is soft for foundations.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_06
data.value: In summer the timber dries fast, so the work goes quicker.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_07
data.value: Autumn is here. Get enough hay ready for winter.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_08
data.value: In winter the coop must be draught-proof. I have a few tricks for that.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_09
data.value: It's raining, so the roof has to be sound. I'm checking every tile.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_10
data.value: Snow on the roofs. The barns need extra straw to keep the animals warm.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_11
data.value: I'm in the workshop at dawn, planing wood before the light is up.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_12
data.value: Evening already. Get the hens into the coop before dark.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_13
data.value: Welcome! I'm Lam. Want to keep hens or a cow? Just ask me.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_14
data.value: Your fields are looking good. Why not add a coop?

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_15
data.value: The deep mine is hard work. When you want more animals, come and see me.

data.name: Npc_carpenter_Line_16
data.value: Midday and I'm still sawing. Stop by for some water first.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_01
data.value: Hello! Something to sell, or looking to buy from other farmers?

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_02
data.value: Market prices follow the sellers. Check the price history before you list.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_03
data.value: I only keep the stall for everyone. What you sell, and at what price, is up to you.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_04
data.value: Fresh goods sell quickly, but don't sell them too cheap.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_05
data.value: Spring greens are going up in price. Have a look before you sell.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_06
data.value: Summer brings buyers looking for melons and tomatoes.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_07
data.value: Autumn brings plenty of goods, so prices may dip a little.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_08
data.value: Winter is lean. Whoever has stock in the store sells for a good price.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_09
data.value: Rain all day, but the buyers still come. Every kind of goods has a place.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_10
data.value: With snow this deep, everyone is stocking up on food.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_11
data.value: Early morning is the busiest time at my stall.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_12
data.value: In the evening I count my stock again. Check your bag too.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_13
data.value: Welcome! I'm Phat. This market is open to everybody.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_14
data.value: Sold your first harvest? This market is a good place to keep going.

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_15
data.value: Ore from the deep mine is fetching good prices. Thinking of selling?

data.name: Npc_trader_Line_16
data.value: Busy at midday. Look at the prices all you like, looking costs nothing.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_01
data.value: Hello! There's work for the whole village on the board today.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_02
data.value: When the village pitches in, every goal gets done sooner.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_03
data.value: The reward is shared with everyone who helps, so nobody loses out.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_04
data.value: A few new delivery requests come in every day. First to finish is paid first.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_05
data.value: It's spring, and the board has new requests for seeds and greens.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_06
data.value: In summer the village needs melons for the festival.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_07
data.value: Autumn, and the board is full of harvest requests. Pick what suits you.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_08
data.value: Winter is here, and the village pools wood and food to keep warm together.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_09
data.value: On a rainy day there's plenty of indoor work. Have a look at the board.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_10
data.value: Snow is falling, and the board has new requests for people who can travel far.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_11
data.value: I pin up new requests at dawn. Come early for the best jobs.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_12
data.value: Evening already. Hand in your work before I clear the board.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_13
data.value: Welcome! I'm Thu. A few small jobs on the board and you'll soon be settled.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_14
data.value: You have your first harvest now. Try taking on a village job.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_15
data.value: You've reached the deep mine. Well done! There's an ore request waiting.

data.name: Npc_board_keeper_Line_16
data.value: Midday. If you're free, look at the board. Many jobs are still unclaimed.
